bias_check.principle: Markets price expectations, not your conviction — weigh valuation, the macro and the data, not just the story.

flags.title: Valuation blind-spot
flags.note: Rich valuation — P/E 27, P/B 8.4. A market-beating chart doesn't make a rich entry safe; the price already discounts a lot of the good news.
flags.lesson: KPIT: strong EV/software story, valuation ignored → about −30%.

flags.title: Chasing strength
flags.note: Extended — 94% up its 52-week range, RS 93, -2% from the high. Momentum isn't an edge by itself — define risk/stop before chasing.
flags.lesson: The market prices expectations; a late entry carries the drawdown, not the edge.

flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Automobile & Auto Components is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +1.05) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

opportunities.point: The company aims to complete its exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next six weeks.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The company aims to introduce two new brands in the 125cc segment during the year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "Further, in the year, we aim to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment to cover the full spectrum of customers in this large segment as well as proposition customers from the 100cc segment to upgrade." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The company is expanding its capacity by nearly 25% to progressively reach 9 million units per annum from the current 7 million.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The capacity expansion will primarily target EVs, high-end motorcycles, and three-wheelers.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "The key areas to address will be EVs, both two-wheelers and three-wheelers, high-end motorcycles and three-wheelers." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: A capex build-up is underway, pointing to future capacity.
opportunities.evidence: CWIP 61 Cr -> 1,521 Cr (2,393%) as of Mar 2026

opportunities.point: The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 12.8% earnings growth vs 17% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: EV/EBITDA is cheaper than the sector median.
A automobile & auto components tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
The domestic two-wheeler industry registrations grew by 14% year-on-year in Q1.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The two-wheeler industry turned in a resilient performance as registrations grew by 14% year-on-year in quarter 1, though much lower than the 25% growth of quarter 4, but under the circumstances, a very healthy performance." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The growth in the two-wheeler industry was driven by EV scooters and the 150cc to 400cc motorcycle segment.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "This growth was driven by EV scooters and the 150cc to 400cc segment of motorcycles." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Capacity has emerged as a key constraint to the company's growth.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Capacities have emerged as a key constraint to growth." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: The stock has a history of very deep drawdowns.
A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
threats.evidence: Price grew 26% vs profit 17% (5Y) — stock ahead of fundamentals; watch valuation.

threats.point: The quarter was impacted by raw material inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions, and a ransomware attack.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "It was a tough quarter with RM inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions as well as a ransomware attack, which you may have read about, but it was defended comprehensively and successfully." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Supply chain issues and other disruptions reduced product availability by approximately 10% to 15%.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "All of these above issues combined impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, more so in exports, high-end bikes and EVs." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Fuel availability became a major challenge early in the quarter due to the curtailment of industrial LPG supplies.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "To start with, fuel availability became a significant challenge early in the quarter following the curtailment of industrial LPG supplies." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar, Jun, Sep) are still in the cycle.
